11046|90f63e56.name: Whuut
11046|90f63e56.text: Can't help you. You know more about potions than I do. Besides, I have pots to watch. Talk to Yelmak over there. He knows a lot about potions.

11047|f018918d.name: Kray
11047|f018918d.text: Your capacity for learning has outstripped mine. You will need to talk to Bena Winterhoof over there for further instruction. Please don't take too much of her time, though. She needs her rest.

11798|a2b097f2.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|a2b097f2.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11868|48da0bbc.name: Sayoc
11868|48da0bbc.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

12042|cf843c85.name: Loganaar
12042|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

205729|2fb0f637.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|2fb0f637.text:
Most impressive that you have noticed me, $r. You may have a talent for the shadows.

I am Boarton Shadetotem, a master of the arts of stealth and subtlety. You may find the idea of a $r rogue implausible, even impossible. For many years I took pride that my skills were mine alone. But I have seen my people face unimaginable challenges, and I now feel a duty to share my knowledge with the tribe.

2128|7d510daf.name: Cain Firesong
2128|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

277055|98eee030.name: Axle Smoothslice
277055|98eee030.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3009|490d29e8.name: Bena Winterhoof
3009|490d29e8.text: Can you not sense the anguish of the Earth Mother for her lost children, the undead? Speak quickly, $N. Every second costs me dearly. We must help them find their way back to her!

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3033|febb65fa.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|febb65fa.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3084|087a1e7e.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|087a1e7e.text: Then head over to Bena's Alchemy on the middle rise and talk to Bena herself.  She will be able to help you master the art of potion brewing.

3084|3f6c5bac.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|3f6c5bac.text: Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism is the one you want to talk to then.  He can be found on the middle rise.

3084|c52e88b9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|c52e88b9.text: Seek out Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise.

3084|de5042ab.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|de5042ab.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3347|2953edc2.name: Yelmak
3347|2953edc2.text: Another student, eh? All right. I'll see what I can do to help you out.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3484|6f0d2d99.name: Kil'hala
3484|6f0d2d99.text: Hey mon, what can I be doin' for you?

3557|cd618670.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|cd618670.text: Ah yes, another who will stoke the fires and forge the weapons of war. Of course I will teach you how.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5624|89fbd152.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|89fbd152.text: Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren $c tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, $c, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

6127-progress.name: Tonga Runetotem
6127-progress.text:
You are the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent, yes?  This is most fortuitous for us!  We are stymied in our effort to bring balance to the sickly gazelles that wander the northern Barrens; we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have?  He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
6127-progress.title: The Principal Source

6128-progress.name: Tonga Runetotem
6128-progress.text: Have you got the reagents I need to make the salve?  The gazelle aren't getting any better on their own, so we better not tarry in our effort to save them!
6128-progress.title: Gathering the Cure

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

861-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
861-progress.text: Greetings.  There is an air about you that tells me much.  Do we have business, you and I?
861-progress.title: The Hunter's Way

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

94913-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
94913-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young $c.
94913-accept.title: Moonglade

94913-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
94913-complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.
94913-complete.title: Moonglade

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away
